glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 口 (“mouth”) + phonetic 阿.
senses: [ā] Used as an initial interjection particle to express surprise. ah, oh, ha
[ā] (Taiwanese Hokkien) Used as an initial interjection particle to raise a topic or change the mood …
[á] Used to indicate doubt or questioning. what?, huh?, eh
[ǎ] Used to indicate puzzled surprise. what? oh? huh?
